text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. At Tracen Academy,
a Christmas party hosted by the Student Council was underway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Held for the Umamusume with no plans to go out,
it's an annual casual party open to voluntary participants, but—
choice_data_list: (To think there's a dress code this year...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, having a Trainer present is mandatory. Since Buena Vista invited me out, I couldn't very well refuse—
choice_data_list: (I tried to tidy it up... but I wonder if it's okay.)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, stooop~.
Time for an inspection!
choice_data_list: Tran... Wait, that outfit—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Formal attire is required, after all~
Anyway, putting me aside for a second.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... hmhmhm.
Oho oho oho...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Brainpower and muscle power are both sufficient. As for charm... that's gone up considerably over the past 3 years. Yep, all good overall!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected, you two look great together.
Have fun~.
choice_data_list: Wh-What was that...?
Wh-What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Was she checking on my outfit?
With that thought in mind, I hurriedly made my way
to the party venue where Buena Vista was waiting—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the venue, everyone was dressed to the nines,
transforming the usual cafeteria into a truly glamorous space.
choice_data_list: (Buena Vista is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I found her right away.
No matter how thick the crowd, her sunflower-like brightness is impossible to miss."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, you're all coming to watch the Arima Kinen together...!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Of course! This year belongs to you, Buena-chan.
You can definitely win, do your best!
choice_data_list: (Surrounded by a crowd as always, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This was a great opportunity, and I wanted her to talk with all sorts of people. So as I watched over her from afar for a while—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Finally here!
...I'm gonna slip away for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting, Trainer-san.
...Your formal attire looks wonderful!
choice_data_list: ...How did you realize that?
...How did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask...?
Hehe!
choice_data_list: Why are you laughing...?
Why are you laughing...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: There's no way I wouldn't notice.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: There's no one else as wonderful as them anywhere in the world.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right. Is it okay if I give you
your Christmas present now?"
choice_data_list: Did you prepare this for me?
Did you get this ready for me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Consider it a token of my daily appreciation...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Sports wear and shoes. Yellow and brown... I matched them using my favorite colors♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we run the perimeter, you follow along on a bike
or in a car, right, Trainer? But... I'd be so happy
if we could... run at the same speed together.
choice_data_list: ...I'll do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you.
I know it's asking for the impossible, but...
will you let me root for you?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. Seeing you two standing side by side, you really do make a great match.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san...!
You're so incredibly cool too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "No, no, well, this kind of thing is all about riding the vibe. Don't worry about me—"
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, thanks for everything up until now.
Oh yeah, thank you for everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right, Tran-san is always watching over me so kindly...!
choice_data_list: She was checking if my outfit was okay earlier too...
She was checking if my outfit was okay earlier too...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even all the way out there!
...You're really so kind, Tran-san!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
......No seriously, you two
are way too perfect for each other.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not about stats or anything... maybe what really matters
is having hearts of the same color...

Trainer,
you just keep getting more wonderful, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I've grown into a better person,
it's all thanks to you"—
I swallowed back the words that instinctively came to mind.

All the girls around us were talking about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
She said she has a truly wonderful trainer.
...She was talking about you.
choice_data_list: No, no, there's no way—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I?
There's no trainer as wonderful as mine anywhere in the world.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I panicked just a little.
Thinking that maybe I'm not worthy of you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you just keep getting more wonderful, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I've grown into a better person,
it's all thanks to you"—
I swallowed back the words that instinctively came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If I've grown into a better person,
it's all thanks to you"—
I swallowed back the words that instinctively came to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The words I want to say are meant to remind her that the Buena Vista I know... is endlessly strong and dazzling.
choice_data_list: ...Then maybe I'll make you sweat a little more.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: And then you will surely overtake me
Then you will surely overtake me

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: You'll shine even brighter.
You will shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"And then,
you'll work hard again... to stand side by side with me, right?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, and here I thought I'd already outgrown playing tag.
choice_data_list: Looks like this will keep going for a while.
Looks like this will keep going for a while.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...You'll wait for me to catch you,
won't you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Is that... a novel?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Nope!
It's a poetry collection by a German poet."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"When I told her I wanted to give it to someone special,
Flash-san told me about it.
...That it carries those kinds of heartfelt feelings."
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll treasure reading it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Go right ahead! There wasn't a Japanese translation,
so I worked hard to translate it myself.
Ehehe, it took a little bit of effort♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. Seeing you two standing side by side, you really do make a great match.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san...!
You're so incredibly cool too!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "No, no, well, this kind of thing is all about riding the vibe. Don't worry about me—"
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, thanks for everything up until now.
Oh yeah, thank you for everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah! You're right, Tran-san is always watching over me so kindly...!
choice_data_list: She was checking if my outfit was okay earlier too...
She was checking if my outfit was okay earlier too...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, even all the way out there!
...You're really so kind, Tran-san!
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
......No seriously, you two
are way too perfect for each other.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's not about stats or anything... maybe what really matters
is having hearts of the same color...

—...It's true! What if we went over and...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's gaze wavers for a moment.
...Her ears are also restlessly picking up the chatter around her, looking uneasy.
choice_data_list: ...Hey, shall we head outside for a bit?

text_block_list.text:
Huh...
Ah, yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
The wind has gotten quite chilly...

text_block_list.text:
I'm fine! I had so much fun chatting with everyone 
that my whole body still feels warm inside.
